The '''Dornean system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]]. Near the edge of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC" /> it contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dornea/Legends|Dornea]], the home planet of the [[Dornean/Legends|Dornean]] species.<ref name="CTD" />
